items.label: High-Performance Processor & Ample Storage
items.value: Powered by the Unisoc T616 Octa-Core 2.0GHz processor, this tablet delivers smooth and responsive performance. With 18GB RAM (6GB + 12GB extended) and 128GB ROM, plus support for up to 1TB TF card expansion, you get seamless multitasking and massive storage capacity for apps, media, and files

items.label: Android 14 with Smart Multitasking
items.value: Runs on the latest Android 14 system, offering a more secure, user-friendly, and customizable experience. Enjoy split-screen and multi-window functionality, making it easy to switch between work, entertainment, and social apps effortlessly

items.label: 11" 2K In-Cell Display for Stunning Visuals
items.value: Featuring a 2000x1200 In-cell 2K display, this tablet boasts enhanced pixel density and true-to-life color reproduction. Whether streaming movies, gaming, or reading, enjoy an immersive, glare-free viewing experience with vibrant details

items.label: Fast & Stable Connectivity with GPS Navigation
items.value: Supports dual-band WiFi (2.4GHz/5GHz) for faster and more stable internet access, along with Bluetooth 5.0 for seamless device pairing. Built-in GPS, A-GPS, GLONASS, and BeiDou provide accurate navigation and location tracking for travel and outdoor activities

items.label: 9000mAh Long-Lasting Battery with Fast Charging
items.value: The 9000mAh high-capacity battery ensures extended usage, delivering 6 hours of video playback, 10 hours of music streaming, and 15 hours of eBook reading. The 5V/3A Type-C fast charging minimizes downtime, keeping you powered throughout the day

items.label: HD Cameras & Immersive Quad-Speaker Audio
items.value: Equipped with a 13MP main + 5MP auxiliary rear camera with autofocus, capturing stunning photos and videos even in low light. The 5MP front camera is ideal for video calls and selfies. Four high-fidelity dual-magnet BOX speakers provide an enhanced stereo sound experience, perfect for gaming, movies, and music

items.label: Complete 2-in-1 Accessory Package
items.value: This tablet comes with a premium leather case, wireless keyboard(Charge with the supplied charger), capacitive stylus, screen protector, OTG cable, charger, and TF card ejector tool, transforming it into a versatile 2-in-1 laptop-style device for maximum productivity and convenience

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: JIZIDP Android Tablet *1, Screen Protector*1, OTG Adapter *1, Tray Eject Pin*1, User Manual*1, Type-C Cable*1, Charger*1, Wireless Keyboard*1, Case*1, Stylus*1
